title: The Clock of Port Mahon
author: Odile Voss
blurb: Jude Vane, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
